user.title: Alexa Room Sync
user.description: Pick the Alexa Media Player account whose Alexa groups should mirror your Home Assistant areas.

abort.no_alexa_media: No Alexa Media Player account is configured. Install and log in to Alexa Media Player first — this integration reuses its session.
abort.already_configured: This Alexa account is already set up.

settings.title: Alexa Room Sync settings
settings.description: Each Home Assistant area gets one Alexa group. Nothing is written to Alexa until you turn dry-run off and tick the confirmation.

data.confirmed_not_dry_run: I understand 'apply' will write to my Alexa account
data.include_child_locks: Put child-lock switches in Alexa groups

skip.name: Areas to skip
skip.description: These areas never get an Alexa group, and don't appear in One area.

remove_rooms.title: Remove the Alexa groups it created
remove_rooms.description: Deletes the Alexa groups this integration created or adopted. A group that also holds something you added yourself, like an Echo, is kept with just those devices. Groups you made yourself are otherwise never touched. Removing the integration on its own does not change Alexa.
